# Sources: third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/geography_functions.md
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/geography_functions.md
# The tessellated line is the observed BigQuery answer in known_bugs.txt, read as WKT or hex WKB.
SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 2, 3 4)', planar => TRUE)
=> "LINESTRING(1 2, 1.5 2.5, 2 3, 2.5 3.5, 3 4)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMWKB('010200000002000000000000000000f03f000000000000004000000000000008400000000000001040', planar => TRUE)
=> "LINESTRING(1 2, 1.5 2.5, 2 3, 2.5 3.5, 3 4)"

# Planar points have no edges to tessellate.
SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(1 2)', planar => TRUE)
=> "POINT(1 2)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMWKB(ST_ASBINARY(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2)), planar => TRUE)
=> "POINT(1 2)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY', planar => TRUE)
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMWKB('010700000000000000', planar => TRUE)
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT(NULL, planar => TRUE)
=> null

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMWKB(CAST(NULL AS BYTES), planar => TRUE)
=> null

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMWKB(CAST(NULL AS STRING), planar => TRUE)
=> null

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(1 2)', planar => NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMWKB(ST_ASBINARY(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2)), planar => NULL)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(0 91)', planar => TRUE)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.ST_GEOGFROMWKB('zz', planar => TRUE)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.ST_GEOGFROMWKB(b'', planar => TRUE)
=> null

# The two options cannot both be TRUE (documented for both parsers).
SELECT SAFE.ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(1 2)', oriented => TRUE, planar => TRUE)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.ST_GEOGFROMWKB(ST_ASBINARY(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2)), oriented => TRUE, planar => TRUE)
=> null
